text:
anya: Quick sync q — finalizing /v1/generate contract for 429s and headers. Do we want both route-level and account-level rate headers present on a 429, and a machine-readable retry field in the body?
samir: Yes to both. Route headers for client routing decisions + global header for billing/overview. Body should include `retry_after_ms` (ms is handy for mobile).
anya: Cool. Also want a small `hint` string in the body to distinguish `route_burst` vs `global_quota`. Keeps client logic simple.
jordan: Agree on `hint`. One more: when we auto-fallback to a lower-capacity model should we return 200 + `X-RateLimit-Fallback` or still 429?
devx: Prefer 200 + explicit fallback header when fallback is successfully served. 429 should mean we couldn't serve the request at all. Otherwise silent 200s break client accounting.
samir: Edge-case: some customers want strict throttling for accounting. Proposal: support opt-in query param `?strict_rate=true`. If set, we return 429 on route-level capacity bust instead of falling back. That should be in the endpoint contract.
anya: Sounds good. Add to spec: default behavior = attempt fallback if configured -> return 200 with `X-RateLimit-Fallback: model-small-v1` and include route/global headers showing remaining tokens; `?strict_rate=true` => 429 and body with `retry_after_ms`.
jordan: Example 429 payload + headers we can add to the docs:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 4
X-RateLimit-Route: /v1/generate
X-RateLimit-Route-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Global-Remaining: 12345
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "retry_after_ms": 4000,
  "hint": "route_burst"
}
```
devx: For SDKs: treat `Retry-After` (seconds) + `retry_after_ms` (body) as authoritative pair; if both present use the larger value. Also emit a structured event `rate.limited` with `scope: route|global|fallback` so app-level telemetry is consistent.
cli-bot: staging flag `rl-headers` enabled for canary at 03:00 PT :rocket:
anya: Thanks — I'll update the API contract doc and add a short FAQ for SDKs (how to handle fallback vs strict). If anyone wants to nitpick header names now is the time. :+1:
